tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
For arrival of L1 bidder sum of Product handling, Local and Upcountry transportation are considered, bidder shall consider the same while quoting the bids

The tenderer should have experienced or handled fast moving consumers goods (Company dealing with alcoholic beverages will not be eligible to participate) or any kind of food products as WC&FA/Wholesale Dealer/Distributor/Super Stockiest or equivalent capacity of reputed companies for a minimum period of 2 years. The proof for the same should be mandatorily uploaded and the experience letter for the same should be submitted in the companys letterhead
Any person/firm associated with any other dairy brand are not eligible to participate.
Any person/firm should not be associated with the employees working in KMF/ Units/District Milk Unions. (Such as relatives/family members/blood relations neither in the form of Partners/Proprietor).

Any firm currently associated with KMF as a Wholesale Dealer, Distributor, or Super Stockist, and any Wholesale Dealer, Distributor, or Super Stockist whose appointment has been cancelled within the preceding one year under the jurisdiction of Sales Depots within Karnataka, shall not be eligible to participate in the tender. However, this restriction shall not apply to Hyderabad and Tirupati Sales Depots.

The tenderer should have minimum turnover as mentioned in the below table in anyone of the last 3 consecutive financial years. Requisite certified Profit & loss statement and other related documents to be attached
Tenderer should submit FSSAI certificate from the concerned local authorities and keep renewed from time to time during the entire course of contract.

Tenderer should furnish Aadhar Card, GST Certificate, FSSAI certificate, PAN Card, 2 years of Financial Statement of the organization running in FMCG products or any organization of food products in nature, godown and other information required for carrying out the WC&FA operations
KMF will have the authority to ask the tenderer to furnish original documents at any point of time, as required by KMF for verification purpose within the stipulated date.
Should be in a position to handle all range of Milk and Milk Products sold under the Brand Name Nandini by KMF

Any objection/change requests with regard to terms and conditions of this tender will not be entertained during the execution of this tender. Any proposals for conditional execution of the work order will result in cancellation of order by forfeiting the security deposit towards liquidated damages

Those Bidders who have backed out from the Contract, prior to the tenure as prescribed in the KMF WC&FA Work Order, will not be further eligible to Participate individually/ in any association or in any form for KMF tenders

Tenderer must submit the exact location/address of their godown facility for verification. The proposed facility must be situated within municipal/corporation limits, feature well-established road connectivity, and meet all standard quality and safety requirements on par with FSSAI norms for the storage of Nandini milk and milk products

The Tenderer shall mandatorily have a Rented, Leased or Own godown for carrying out the activities specified under the tender. In case of a rented/ leased godown, the bidder shall submit a valid copy of the Rental / Lease Agreement with the tender documents. In case of an own godown, the bidder shall submit valid documentary proof of ownership. The bidder shall also produce the original/valid supporting documents before KMF as and when required.

The WC&FA shall ensure that each Ghee box/carton dispatched from the respective Milk Unions/Units/Bengaluru Depot is provided with a QR Code and that 100% of inward and outward movements are scanned by using the QR Code Scanner provided by KMF. The accurate stock movement records maintained accordingly.
The WC&FA shall deploy adequate manpower/staff for carrying out the scanning and related inward/outward stock-handling activities efficiently and without any delay.
The WC&FA shall be responsible for the safe custody and proper functioning of the QR Code Scanner provided by KMF during the contract period
